---
id: "smk-14"
title: "Juventus"
---

Juventus is a professional football club based in Turin, in the Piedmont region of Italy. It was founded in 1897 by a group of students and has spent most of its history under the ownership of the Agnelli family, which also controls the carmaker Fiat. Juventus has won more Italian league championships than any other club, along with many Italian Cups and two European Cups. The club plays in black and white striped shirts, a design adopted in 1903 after an English supporter sent a set of Notts County shirts. Since 2011 Juventus has played at its own stadium in Turin, one of the few club-owned grounds in Italy. Its rivalries with Inter Milan and with Torino, the other club of the city, are among the most intense in the country. Juventus was relegated to the second division in 2006 after a match-fixing scandal but returned to the top flight the following season.
